title: Phobia's Tweaks
description: Just some little admin tweaks for neoforge to make your life way easier
body:
# **Phobia's Tweaks**

Phobia's Tweaks is a mod that adds utilities for admins in Minecraft Servers.

It adds the commands: /admin and /admin_give

Choices for /admin are counter, instant kill, invincibility and security

## **Command function**

'Counter' gives damage-back to entities that attack any player with this set to true

'Instant Kill' makes you do 1000 attack damage, basically allowing you to instantly kill anything in one hit

'Invincibility' is self-explanatory, making it impossible for you to die no matter how much damage you take

'Security' makes it so you cannot be deopped or banned, allowing your moderators to have deop and ban commands without fear of betrayal (also useful incase you have any 'SpokeIsHere' type people on your SMP ツ)

And /admin_give just gives you 64 of whatever item you like (idk why i added this)
